items.title: How Investors May Respond To Abbott (ABT) TAVI Trial Launch
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories has begun the VOYAGER CE clinical trial of its investigational Encantor software guided balloon expandable TAVI system, enrolling up to 300 patients in Europe and Australia with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis. The Encantor platform, built using physician feedback and learnings from the Navitor portfolio, targets more controlled valve deployment and customized fit. items.title: Can Boston Scientific Stock Rise 30% From Here?
items.summary: Boston Scientific still has a business growing fast, yet its share price appears to treat the whole company as stalled. That business is interventional cardiology, which treats blocked heart arteries. On its October 28 call, the company said the unit grew 19% from a year earlier in the third quarter. Total company sales grew only 1.4% in that quarter.
